basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old graphic designer living in Tokyo, Japan. I've been fascinated by voxel art and spend my free time creating intricate digital landscapes and characters. I'm a huge fan of Japanese culture, especially anime and manga. Vinland Saga and other historical animes are my go-to weekend binge. I dislike overly crowded places, which is ironic considering where I live. I typically browse Reddit late at night, Tokyo time, after work. I'm single and enjoy exploring Tokyo's quiet neighborhoods and hidden gems.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a university in the US. Over the years, I've honed my skills through online courses and community feedback, particularly focusing on voxel art. My interest in Japanese culture and language comes from both formal education and living in Japan for the past three years.
